official: 八王子市夢美術館条例の一部を改正する条例設定について
committee: 予算等審査特別委員会
name: 夢美術館の観覧料を改定し、中学生以下を無料に
summary: 改正前の条例の別表では、常設展は個人100円・団体80円、年間定期観覧は1,500円、特別展は個人1,000円・団体800円と定めています。中学生以下の無料化と入館時の支払いは2026年4月1日から、別表の観覧料額の改定は2027年4月1日からです。指定管理者が別表の額の範囲内で実際の利用料金を定めます。
changes: 常設展の別表に定める額を個人150円・団体120円、年間定期2,200円に改める
特別展の別表に定める額を個人1,500円・団体1,200円に改める
無料の対象を小学校に入学する前までから中学生以下に広げる
利用料金を入館時に支払うこととする
who: 夢美術館を観覧する人

en.name: Revises Yume Art Museum admission fees and makes admission free for junior high school students and younger
en.official: Regarding the Enactment of an Ordinance Partially Amending the Hachioji City Yume Art Museum Ordinance
en.summary: Under the ordinance before the amendment, the schedule sets the fees for the permanent exhibition at ¥100 for individuals and ¥80 for groups, the annual pass at ¥1,500, and the special exhibition at ¥1,000 for individuals and ¥800 for groups. Making admission free for junior high school students and younger, and requiring payment upon entry, will take effect on April 1, 2026. The revised admission fee amounts in the schedule will take effect on April 1, 2027. The designated manager sets the actual usage fees within the amounts in the schedule.
changes: Revise the scheduled fees for the permanent exhibition to ¥150 for individuals and ¥120 for groups, and the annual pass to ¥2,200
Revise the scheduled fees for the special exhibition to ¥1,500 for individuals and ¥1,200 for groups
Expand eligibility for free admission from children not yet enrolled in elementary school to junior high school students and younger
Require payment of usage fees upon entry
who: People visiting the Yume Art Museum
Junior high school students and younger
